annotations.title: See a trainer's profile and plans

description: Show the public profile of one personal trainer from the Trainer Connect directory: bio, specialties, where they work, online or in person, and the plans they publish with price and billing period. The person contacts the trainer or signs up for a plan on the profile_url page; this connector never books, pays or sends messages.
